blocks.text: This document was developed through a broad, inclusive, and consultative process involving diverse stakeholders across the health sector. Such a participatory approach promotes shared ownership of the Standard Treatment Guidelines and National Essential Medicines List for Tanzania (STG and NEMLIT) and enhances commitment to its effective implementation. The review process began in October 2024 with the identification of key stakeholders, who were provided with a structured tool to systematically gather their recommendations. These recommendations were based on their experience with the use, awareness, and implementation of the STG/NEMLIT, as well as their assessment of its effectiveness, relevance, and areas requiring improvement.

blocks.text: The Ministry of Health conducted a survey to gather recommendations for the review of the Standard Treatment Guidelines and National Essential Medicines List for Tanzania (STG and NEMLIT). A wide range of stakeholders participated in this process, including healthcare facilities from Dodoma, Geita, Iringa, Kigoma, Mbeya, Ruvuma, Mtwara, Tabora, Manyara, and Dar es Salaam, representing primary, secondary, and tertiary levels of care. These facilities actively contributed valuable recommendations to inform the review.
